captions.caption: The camera pans across a mossy forest floor with scattered leaves.
A close-up view of the ground shows dirt and small plants in the forest.
The camera moves over a rocky area covered in green moss.
A mossy rock wall is shown as the camera tilts downwards.
A person's hand reaches towards a green camouflage backpack on the ground.
The person begins to unzip the main compartment of the backpack.
The backpack is being opened to reveal its contents in the forest.
A hand pulls an object out from the inside of the camouflage bag.
The handle of a small axe is visible as it is removed from the bag.
The person completely pulls the small axe out of the backpack.
A man in a beanie and jacket stands in the woods holding the axe.
The man looks at the camera while holding his axe in the sunlight.
The man turns and begins walking deeper into the dense forest.
A view of many tall trees and fallen branches in a sunny forest.
The camera pans through the trees, showing the forest environment.
Looking up at the high canopy of the evergreen trees in the woods.
The sun shines through the branches of the tall trees overhead.
The camera focuses on a specific tall, thin tree trunk in the forest.
A view of the upper branches of a tree against the bright sky.
The camera continues to look up at the tree's needles and branches.
The tree branches sway slightly in the breeze against the sunlight.
The camera begins to pan down from the top of the tall tree.
The camera moves down the trunk of the tree towards the ground.
The base of the trees and the forest floor come back into view.
The camera scans the ground filled with moss and dead branches.
A view of the underbrush and small trees growing in the forest.
The camera focuses on a small, thin standing dead tree.
The small tree stands prominently in the middle of the frame.
The man walks into the shot towards the small standing tree.
The man approaches the base of the tree with his axe in hand.
The man positions himself to start chopping the small tree down.
The man swings the axe and makes the first cut into the tree base.
The man pulls the axe back to prepare for another swing.
The man swings the axe again, hitting the same spot on the trunk.
The axe strikes the wood, creating a visible notch in the tree.
The man continues to chop rhythmically at the base of the small tree.
Another forceful swing of the axe hits the tree trunk.
The man chips away more wood from the base of the tree.
The man pauses briefly to assess the cut he has made.
The man resumes chopping, swinging the axe at the tree base.
The axe makes a sharp sound as it bites into the dry wood.
The man readies himself for another strike on the tree trunk.
The man swings the axe again with both hands on the handle.
The tree begins to show signs of weakening as he chops.
The man continues to focus his axe strikes on the lower trunk.
Another hit from the axe sends small wood chips into the air.
The man uses his axe to cut deeper into the side of the tree.
The man puts his hand on the tree to test its stability.
The man pushes the tree trunk to see if it will break easily.
The man adjusts his stance slightly while standing by the tree.
The man looks down at the notch he has cut into the tree.
The man raises the axe once more to continue chopping.
The man stands ready with the axe in front of the small tree.
The man swings the axe and hits the tree trunk again.
The axe strikes the wood with a solid thud in the quiet forest.
The man continues his work of felling the small dead tree.
Another swing of the axe lands precisely in the cut area.
The man delivers another blow to the base of the tree trunk.
The man stops chopping for a moment and looks at the tree.
The man stands by the partially cut tree, preparing his next swing.
